description: Create a drawing of a part, Part Studio or assembly. The source must be referenced by version — call onshape_create_version first and pass its id as src_version.

part.description: Part id, to draw a single part.

src_doc.description: Source document id (defaults to the target document).

src_version.description: Version id of the source element.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_create_drawing
title: Create a drawing
